assets.subject: Terence V. Powderly
assets.provenance: Source-derived stylized portrait. The underlying period visual evidence is Library of Congress record 2012648823, "Leaders of the Knights of Labor" (Kurz & Allison, 1886), which carries a Terence V. Powderly bust portrait and the rights statement "No known restrictions on publication." Record verified on the Library of Congress item API before publication. The deployed image is a stylization built from that reference, not an archival photograph, and the page says so where it appears.
assets.responsiveCrop: Keep face recognizable while retaining typography zone.

assets.subject: Jay Gould
assets.provenance: Library of Congress photograph "[Jay Gould, half-length portrait, facing left]", between 1865 and 1892, subject heading "Gould, Jay,--1836-1892.", rights statement "No known restrictions on publication." Record verified on the Library of Congress item API and the image visually confirmed to be the correct person before use. Tonal grade only: crop, grayscale normalisation, a duotone sampled from approved asset A04, and light grain. Nothing in the photograph is added, removed, or repainted. Credited on the page as an archival photograph with its record URL.
assets.htmlSafeZone: Caption column beside the plate carries all typography; the photograph itself is never overprinted.
assets.responsiveCrop: Plate narrows on small screens; head and shoulders must remain inside the frame.
